canonical_project: Apatura Plean / Torwood AI Data Centre Campus

location.country: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

notes: Apatura submitted a PAN to Stirling and Falkirk councils for a 43.1 ha Plean/Torwood campus (300MW utility capacity) but changed location to Larbert (Glenbervie Business Park, Falkirk), where a full planning application was lodged 29 May 2026; the Stirling/Plean site did not proceed so is coded rejected for this division; no other Stirling facility found.
